item.title: Idol Ura Eigyou ~Kegasareta Stage Ishou~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Channel Ubai
  • 発売日: 2019-07-26
  • スコア: 6.4/10 (41 人評価)
  • 日本語名: アイドル裏営業 ～汚されたステージ衣装～
  • 英語名: Idol Ura Eigyou Kegasareta Stage Ishou

あらすじ

Struggling idol Amamiya Suzune is approached by her new male CEO with an offer of engaging in pillow business in exchange for success. Despite never considering such actions before, Suzune decides to go through with it in order to become a top idol and please her manager, Tsuji Yuusuke. However, the path to success is not easy, as she must contend with a popular rival idol Kitou Kirara and the problems that come with a newfound popularity.
